The '''battle of the Koban Gorge''' was an isolated incident that resulted from [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Polvin Kut]]'s intervention on behalf of the citizens of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Koba]], who were suffering under the oppression of [[Tulak]], an [[Advozse/Legends|Advozse]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]]. Along with his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Yaddle/Legends|Yaddle]], Master Kut battled Tulak's Advozsec legions on a [[Polvin Kut memorial bridge|bridge]] overlooking the [[Koban Gorge]], but the Jedi Master was defeated as insurmountable numbers of the enemy swarmed and [[Death/Legends|killed]] him. Yaddle was subsequently taken captive and spent over a [[Standard century/Legends|century]] as Tulak's [[Prison/Legends|prisoner]].
